[[Lovisa's Love]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]].  As the name suggests, it is the replica of the staff used by [[Inquisitor Lovisa]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]])
:Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of Healing Prayers spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Healing Prayers]] +1 (Chance: 20% while using skills)

==Skin==
Has the same skin as the [[Turquoise Staff]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create a technical replica (excluding visual appearance) for this item with:
*One of the following [[Healing Prayers]] [[staves]]:
**[[Holy Branch]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]].
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Mastery]] OR [[of Attribute|of Healing Prayers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Aptitude not Attitude]]" inscription

==Notes==
* The skin for the Turquoise Staff is normally not found with a healing prayers attribute requirement.
* Lovisa's Love is a Healing Prayers monk staff, but the boss where the name of the staff is based upon (Inquisitor Lovisa) is a fire elementalist boss (although she does use [[Heal Party]] in her skill bar).
